First-run defaults loaded; click Save &: Valori iniziali caricati. Premi Salva e applica.
Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or: Focus the shortcut box and press Ctrl or Alt with a letter, digit or function key, then Save & Apply. F12 and reserved combinations are rejected. If registration conflicts, the previous shortcut remains active. Clear and save to disable it.

Global Scale changes the whole HUD size;: Global Scale changes the whole HUD size; opacity controls its visibility. Font selection changes text rendering, with system fallback for missing glyphs. High load: cpu.usage, Threshold >= 90, c: High load: cpu.usage, Threshold >= 90, cooldown 30 seconds. Track changes: media.title with Change mode and a suitable cooldown. Confirm that the variable returns valid data before relying on a trigger.
Hot zones are available with Always Visi: Hot zones are available with Always Visible off. Set the anchor, size, offsets and dwell time. The region uses full target-display bounds and is clamped to the screen. Dwell for the chosen interval to summon; leave and re-enter to re-arm. You may advance the carousel on each summon.
ICMP uses Ping; TCP measures connect lat: ICMP usa Ping; TCP misura la connessione; UDP invia dati e attende risposta.
Imported startup preference could not be: Avvio importato non applicato. Controlla le app di avvio Windows.
In AIDA64 Preferences → Hardware Monitor: In AIDA64 Preferences → Hardware Monitoring → External Applications, select the items and enable shared memory, Registry or WMI. Keep AIDA64 running, then refresh ECP Hardware Data. ECP reads all actual exports, including numbers, timings and text; unexported or license-limited fields remain unavailable.
Initial and recovered samples establish: Initial and recovered samples establish a baseline without popping up. Each rule has its own cooldown; a sustained threshold can trigger again after it expires. Matching rules summon the next item in that instance's queue, or the active profile for an empty queue. Rules work only in transient mode.

Network profiles can use automatic byte: Network profiles can use automatic byte units or Mbps; 1 MB/s equals 8 Mbps. The ring compares total, download, upload or the larger direction with your reference bandwidth. The reference sets the 100% scale and does not limit or benchmark the network.

New keys identify a specific device and sensor. Highest/average summaries have different meanings and remain separate. -- means no valid value is currently available.
One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, ho: One CPU/GPU may expose package, core, hotspot, memory and multiple power channels. Similar names can represent different measurements. Sensor min/max values are session history, not hardware limits. SMBIOS module information comes from firmware and is not a complete SPD/XMP/EXPO timing table.
Open the config folder from the top bar: Open the config folder from the top bar and the logs folder from About. Keep source status or hardware diagnostics when troubleshooting. Reset loads first-run defaults; Save & Apply commits them to the running app.
